programme.title: JMC Broadcasting - Executive Orders and The Blueprint of the 45-47 Operation
programme.desc:
Its not a conspiracy Its a continuity of government military operation And the blueprint has been hiding in plain sight for years
In this landmark Special Broadcast John Michael Chambers sits down with Derek Johnson—retired veteran author and one of the most respected voices on military law and executive orders—for a master class on the operation that is reshaping America
Johnson reveals the four components of a PEAD Presidential Emergency Action Document executive orders national emergencies proclamations and treaties He walks through Executive Order 13848—the election interference order that deployed the National Guard to the polls for the first time in US history He explains the critical line Although no foreign power has altered the outcome or vote tabulation—meaning the enemy is within He connects Executive Orders 13903 13928 and 13959 to the seizure of assets the blockade of the deep state and the sudden resignations of Fortune 500 CEOs after January 11 2021
This is a military government President Trump is the Supreme Commander The Law of War Manual is the operational handbook And the endorsements he makes—businessmen veterans special operators—are straight out of Eisenhowers contingency plan
